{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute response rate within each severity stratum for each site
response_by_site_severity = df_dedup.groupby(['site', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute overall severity distribution
severity_dist = df_dedup['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Standardise response rates to the overall severity distribution
# This is done by computing a weighted average of the stratum-specific rates
# using the overall severity distribution as weights
standardised_response_rate = {}
for site in response_by_site_severity.index:
    rates = response_by_site_severity.loc[site]
    weights = severity_dist
    # Ensure weights sum to 1
    weights = weights / weights.sum()
    # Compute weighted average
    std_rate = (rates * weights).sum()
    standardised_response_rate[site] = std_rate

# Convert to DataFrame
std_rates_df = pd.DataFrame(list(standardised_response_rate.items()), columns=['site', 'standardised_response_rate'])

# Sort by standardised response rate
top_site = std_rates_df.loc[std_rates_df['standardised_response_rate'].idxmax()]

# Print results
std_rates_df, top_site"}
